extension.summary: Backup and restore LibreELEC system settings and configurations
extension.description: Automatically backup and restore your LibreELEC system settings, configurations, and addons. Supports local and remote storage locations with smart backup rotation.
extension.disclaimer: This addon is not affiliated with LibreELEC or Kodi.
extension.news: v1.5.0 (2026-04-12) - FEATURE RELEASE - Added custom dashboard and backup browser windows with skin XML layouts. - New custom settings/help details for better guidance. - Added backup summary popup toggle in Notifications. - Remote storage usage now visible on dashboard. - Improved restore UX with reliable progress and less notification noise. - Detailed, colorized operation summaries added. - Improved backup detection and date parsing for all naming formats. - Hardened restore handling for file permission/path errors. - Cleaned up Remote Settings Test Connection diagnostics. - Switched all popups to custom GUI dialogs with fallback support. - Fixed Credits display and settings navigation edge cases. - Automatic mounting/unmounting of addons directory during restore.
